title: Compact Master Inventory Matrix
summary: Reformats Master Kitchen Inventory to match the supplied compact family, storage-form, Have, Buy, and Notes matrix.
behavior: Displays each food family once rather than repeating its name for every product form.
Groups product variations beneath Fresh, Frozen, Canned, Jarred, Refrigerated, Instant, Dry, and other storage-form labels.
Uses two compact variation columns with a Have and Buy quantity pair for every form.
Stores one shared Notes field for each food family.
Expands Beans, Carrots, Peas, and Potatoes to match the supplied inventory examples.
Preserves accordion categories, search, purchases, custom items, printing, iPad responsiveness, and Backup & Restore.
